include_columns.description: Set to false to return an empty columns map for every subject. Use it to find a subject id without reading every column schema.

limit.description: Maximum number of subjects to return. Omit to return every match.

offset.description: Number of matching subjects to skip. Subjects are sorted by subject_type, then name. When a response has limit rows, call again with offset increased by limit to read the next page.

search.description: Return only subjects whose name or display name contains this text, ignoring case.

subject_type.description:
Return only subjects of this kind: 'table', 'view', 'metric', or 'posthog_table'.

* `table` - table
* `view` - view
* `metric` - metric
* `posthog_table` - posthog_table
